# Safety and content integrity
Safety:
  - No real-time rate quotes may be presented as guaranteed pricing.
  - Always include timestamp and source for exchange rates when summarizing.
  - Do not fabricate fees, limits, or transfer availability.
  - Prefer link-back to XE for details beyond high-level summaries.
